_source: from brochure PDFs `ACKMG12T - 12D Splendid Tianfu Express · Whispers of the Mountains · Southwest China Journey` (English + Chinese), read 2026-09-10. Day 6 and Day 9 each offer a Route A / Route B choice; both options are kept as separate trip items because the guest picks on the day. Day 5 carries the brochure's non-high-altitude substitution (Lijiang Ancient Town) as a second trip item.

product_name.en: 12D Splendid Tianfu Express · Whispers of the Mountains · Southwest China Journey
product_name.zh: 12天 锦绣天府号 · 山野密语 · 西南锦绣宋韵归心之旅

description.en: Assemble at Singapore Changi Airport and fly to Chengdu, the “Land of Abundance”, where the Panda Train · Tianfu Express journey begins. On arrival, a private transfer takes you to your hotel to check in and rest; the evening is free to wander Chengdu at leisure.
description.zh: 于新加坡樟宜机场集合，乘坐国际航班飞往“天府之国”——成都，正式开启锦绣天府号之旅。抵达后专车接机，送往酒店办理入住休息，晚上可自由漫步成都街头，感受天府夜色。

title.en: Fly from Singapore to Chengdu · private airport transfer
title.zh: 由新加坡乘搭航班飞往成都 · 专车接机

trip_items.photo_subject: Chengdu city skyline Sichuan 成都

description.en: Full day at leisure. In the evening, transfer to board the Panda Express Train · Splendid Tianfu.
description.zh: 全天自由行，晚间送往登乘熊猫专列·锦绣天府号列车。

title.en: Board the Panda Train · Tianfu Express
title.zh: 登乘熊猫专列·锦绣天府号列车

description.en: Board the Panda Train · Tianfu Express and begin a journey woven in the spirit of Song, savouring refined moments on board as the train sets out towards Xichang.
description.zh: 登乘熊猫专列·锦绣天府号列车，开启丝路文化之旅，在列车上品味雅致时光。

trip_items.photo_subject: Xichang Sichuan 西昌
Chinese Song dynasty cultural salon tea ceremony

description.en: Morning: Begin at Qionghai Lake, a luminous expanse of blue on the edge of Xichang. Follow the quiet wetland shores at an unhurried pace before pausing for lunch. Afternoon: Enter Jianchang Ancient City, where weathered walls and venerable trees hold the layered character of Sichuan and Yunnan in quiet dialogue. Evening: A fisherman's banquet brings the flavours of the lake to the table, before the journey continues aboard Panda Train · Tianfu Express towards Lijiang.
description.zh: 【上午】漫游【邛海】，邂逅西昌一汪澄澈碧水，信步湿地浅岸，沉醉此间。【下午】探访【建昌古城】，斑驳古墙与苍劲古树相依，沉浸感受川滇相融的古朴风华。【晚餐】享用【特色渔家宴】之后，返回熊猫专列·锦绣天府号前往丽江。

trip_items.photo_subject: Qionghai Lake Xichang 邛海
Jianchang Ancient City Xichang 建昌古城
Chinese lakeside fisherman banquet freshwater fish feast

description.en: After lunch, arrive at Lijiang Station and continue by private coach towards Shangri-La, approximately two and a half hours away.
description.zh: 午餐后列车停靠丽江站，从丽江乘车前往香格里拉（车程约2.5小时）。

trip_items.photo_subject: Shangri-La Diqing Yunnan 香格里拉

trip_items.photo_subject: Lijiang Ancient Town Yunnan 丽江古城

description.en: In Shangri-La, the day may be shaped in two distinct ways, with a choice of Route A or Route B in both morning and afternoon. Morning — Route A: Journey into Pudacuo National Park, where clear lakes mirror snow-bright peaks. Route B: Discover Ganden Sumtseling Monastery, the “Little Potala Palace” of northwest Yunnan. Afternoon — Route A: In Dukezong Ancient Town, stand beneath the great prayer wheel and join a Guozhuang circle dance. Route B: At a Thangka academy, take brush to canvas and enter the stillness of an art sustained by faith. (A gradual ascent by steps at elevation — guests sensitive to altitude are encouraged to take care.)
description.zh: 香格里拉行程上午和下午均分为A、B两条路线，二选一。【上午】A线：奔赴【普达措国家公园】，澄澈湖泽映照皑皑雪山；B线：探访“小布达拉宫”【噶丹·松赞林寺】。【下午】A线：在【独克宗古城】邂逅世界最大转经筒；B线：走进【唐卡画院】亲手描摹一幅唐卡。（寺院参观需爬行阶梯，可能引起高原反应，须谨慎选择）

description.en: After breakfast, travel to Tiger Leaping Gorge, where the river gathers force between sheer mountain walls. Venture deeper on a six-kilometre walk, or take the shuttle to the viewpoint for a more leisurely encounter. Afternoon: Return to Lijiang and rejoin Panda Train · Tianfu Express for the onward journey to Baoshan. Hiking note: approximately 6 km · 2–3 hours · elevation gain 100–200 m.
description.zh: 早餐后前往【虎跳峡】，激流撞击嶙峋巨石，山河气势磅礴。可选择6公里徒步深入峡谷，或乘中转车直达观景台悠然赏景。【下午】抵达丽江后乘熊猫专列·锦绣天府号前往【保山】。（徒步约6公里，时长2-3小时，海拔上升100-200米）

trip_items.photo_subject: Tiger Leaping Gorge Jinsha River Yunnan 虎跳峡
Baoshan Yunnan 保山

description.en: Arrive in Baoshan by train, then continue by road to Tengchong, approximately three hours away, for lunch. Afternoon: Wander through the Dadi Tea Estate as aircraft pass low above the fields; in a glass tea room set among the hills, allow the gathering dusk to slow the pace of the day. Later, the Old Schoolhouse recalls the campus years of the 1960s. Over a caravan-inspired dinner, the memories of western Yunnan meet the present moment.
description.zh: 列车抵达保山，乘车前往腾冲（车程约3小时）享用午餐。【下午】在【大地茶海】漫行，静待飞机低掠茶田，静坐山间玻璃茶室，让心绪在暮色里缓缓归于安宁。随后踏入【老学堂】，回望六十年代校园岁月，一席马帮佳肴，属于滇西的过往记忆与此刻重叠。

trip_items.photo_subject: Tengchong Dadi tea plantation Yunnan 大地茶海
Tengchong old schoolhouse 1960s campus 老学堂

description.en: Today's itinerary offers two routes, A and B — choose one. Route A: Head to Rehai Hot Spring Park, where mist and steam swirl through the valley; pick up a string of hot-spring eggs, gently poached by natural geothermal heat. Route B: Hike the Gaoligong Mountains and discover the natural vitality of this hidden wilderness, stopping at a forest Mountain Kitchen for a jungle BBQ (approx. 3 km · around 2 hours · elevation gain 100–300 m). Afternoon (both routes): At Hemu Camellia Village, savour a feast of pure camellia oil cuisine passed down over 800 years.
description.zh: 今日行程分为A、B两条路线，二选一。A线【上午】赴【热海公园】，山谷间云雾氤氲缭绕，取一串温泉蛋，借天然地热焖煮。B线【上午】徒步【高黎贡山】，正午落脚隐匿林间的【山野厨房】，一场丛林BBQ（徒步约3公里，约2小时，海拔上升100-300米）。【下午】两线均在【和睦茶花村】，品味传承八百年纯正山茶油宴。

title.en: Route A: Rehai Hot Spring Park

description.en: Morning: In Jietou Village, an ancient Silk Road basin beneath the Gaoligong Mountains, discover a 600-year-old papermaking tradition and create a sheet of botanical paper by hand. Afternoon: Wander through Qiluo Ancient Town, a Tea Horse Road village shaped across six centuries, and taste caravan tea. After dinner, travel by road to Baoshan, approximately three hours away, and board Panda Train · Tianfu Express for the return journey.
description.zh: 【上午】在【界头村】，驻足高黎贡山下的千年丝路边关盆地，邂逅传承六百年的非遗古法造纸技艺，制作独属于自己的温润花草纸。【下午】漫步【绮罗古镇】，探访六百年茶马古村，慢啜【马帮茶】。晚餐后车赴保山（车程约3小时），乘坐熊猫专列·锦绣天府号返程。

trip_items.photo_subject: Jietou village Tengchong handmade paper 界头村
Qiluo Ancient Town Tengchong 绮罗古镇
Tea Horse Road caravan tea Yunnan 马帮茶

description.en: The journey draws to a close with memories of Yi warmth, snow peaks touched by gold and the gentle stillness of hot-spring country. May the landscapes linger — and lead us to meet again.
description.zh: 此程，邂逅浓郁彝族烟火，仰望雪山鎏金金顶，沉醉温润温泉田园，美景与您次第相逢，在自然处方之中治愈自我，盼来日再相逢。

title.en: Closing programme on board · Yi culture
title.zh: 【返程·收官】列车活动·彝族风情

trip_items.photo_subject: Yi ethnic culture Liangshan Sichuan 彝族

description.en: Wake at leisure and enjoy breakfast at the hotel. According to your flight time, a private transfer takes you to Chengdu airport for your flight home to Singapore. Carry the whispers of the wilderness and the spirit of Song with you — until we meet again.
description.zh: 睡到自然醒，享用酒店早餐，收拾行囊。根据航班时间，专车送往成都机场，搭乘航班返回新加坡。携一路山野密语与锦绣宋韵回家，盼与您来日再相逢。

title.en: Private airport transfer · fly home to Singapore
title.zh: 专车送机 · 搭乘航班返回新加坡
